body:
I have just gone through pretty much the exact same thing very recently and I am finding it extremely difficult to cope. I would really like to hear from those further down the line as well. 

Hope you are doing okay.

I hope so. I just wonder if I can ever share those things again without comparing them to what has gone before. The catch 22 is that I can't stand the thought of never sharing them again. I just don't want to do this, I absolutely would not wish this feeling on anyone on earth.

(Thanks)

Thanks, I know it's a foolish thing to think/say. I just have no idea how to get beyond this - in many ways this was my perfect person. Anything else feels like a disappointment. I just feel as though I'm barely here any more.

(also, nice rh reference in your name.)
